scope.behavior: Restricted runtime publisher dispatch and package-writer identity

before_value.entry_point: Manual workflow_dispatch on protected ElevenID/.github main
before_value.writer: Required dedicated classic write:packages PAT from a package-only account; never provisioned
before_value.context_probe: No source-free reusable callee identity probe

after_value.entry_point: Manual main dispatch in private ElevenID/feature-regression-private-publisher calls the protected central reusable workflow
after_value.writer: Private caller GITHUB_TOKEN with job packages:write
after_value.package_actions_access: Only the private publisher repository receives Manage Actions write for the existing unlinked private package
after_value.context_probe: probe-only dispatch checks callee identity in a read-only job before source access or package publication

decisions.compatibility_impact: The old direct central dispatch and planned personal writer token are retired. Operators must dispatch the private caller; existing application deployment and package consumers are unchanged. The old path never published a restricted runtime image.
decisions.replacement_behavior: The private caller invokes the protected central workflow and uses its short-lived job token to publish after exact context, source, and package-visibility checks; the operator verifies $0 budgets and available storage before dispatch.
